sources.title: ERKLA-Quartett concert notice
sources.researchNote: The notice announces an ERKLA-Quartett concert at the Liederhalle in Stuttgart on 23 April 1929. It does not name Bronisław Kaper and is retained only as contextual evidence for the ensemble.
